submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create one corrected full-body transparent game sprite: water dragon scholar boy, EAST (screen-right) hit recoil peak, frame 03 of 06. Output one square native image at least 1024x1024 (prefer 1254x1254), RGBA alpha, no sheet.
Inputs: image 1 is the correct EAST-side anatomy and head-volume reference; image 2 is definitive front-view identity and right-hand fan ownership; image 3 is the hit pose EDIT TARGET whose hands are wrong; image 4 is the approved PRIMARY painting style reference only.
Edit image 3's arm ownership and hip accessory side while keeping the established recoil concept and character identity. The character faces screen RIGHT; the camera sees his anatomical RIGHT side. Therefore the large near shoulder and large near sleeve visible in front of the torso belong to the RIGHT arm. Draw that near RIGHT upper arm descending from the clearly visible shoulder, right elbow bent by the ribs, right forearm rising diagonally across the near chest, and RIGHT hand clearly gripping the pivot of the open ivory blue-water-dragon fan at the chest. Make an unbroken, clearly readable connection from near right shoulder through sleeve and elbow to the fan-gripping hand. The ivory fan lies in FRONT of this near-side right forearm and chest, not on the far arm.
The far anatomical LEFT shoulder is partly occluded behind the chest. Its LEFT empty arm extends backward toward screen-left behind the near right arm for balance. Show exactly one small empty far hand behind the body; distinguish the far sleeve by occlusion. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, two boots. Move the large hip jade medallion to anatomical LEFT hip (far side in this E view), mostly occluded; keep the small jade bead/fan tassel attached to the fan pivot, not the hip.
Pose: incoming impact from screen RIGHT, torso recoils about 12 degrees toward screen LEFT; both feet remain planted separately, knees visibly bent. Nose still points RIGHT, eyes briefly pinched closed, non-graphic cartoon flinch. Maintain stable pelvis/root around x=50% of the canvas, virtual ground around y=95%; head and shoulders lean with the recoil rather than translating the whole character. Keep the large rounded head volume, short limbs and exact costume from image 1. Two planted boots must show distinct ankle/shin connections, no running leg pose.
Preserve navy straight layered hair/small ponytail, turquoise-gold ornament and blue tassel, blue eyes when open, blue/ivory/gold scholar robe and cloud-wave motifs, single ivory-blue folding fan. High-finish bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand painting matching image 4; no UI, no text, no border, no background, no ground shadow, no magic effects, no particles, no duplicate limbs, no motion blur. Full hair tassel, fan tips, sleeves, and both boots fully inside the canvas with margin. Do not mirror the image.
